profile.headline: Federated Security Group at Travelers
profile.summary: A proven leader of on-shore and off-shore development teams delivering within Agile programs. Offers expertise in the creation of technical solutions that meet the tactical and operational needs of the business. Oversees team and individual development and supports continuous technological and process improvement.  Possesses a broad range of IT knowledge gained in multiple managerial and technical roles; primarily within the Insurance industry.

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
Currently manage the  day to day and strategic activities with a staff of up to 60, that includes: Scrum Masters, Developers, Testers, Architects and Business Analysts. Oversee planning, development, testing and deployment of the product suite. Ensure the product is delivered on time, within budget and in line with engineering standards. 
•	Advocated and drove the organization’s adoption of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) into the engineering practices and processes.
o	Increased delivery predictability and quality.
•	Boosts continuous improvement by regular retrospection activities and reviews.
o	Targeting quality improvement by defensive programming, enhanced unit testing, realistic test scenarios and data.
•	Stimulates closer relationships with offshore teams and introduced an increase in responsibility for mid-tier management roles.
•	Created reporting tool that enables an increase in management efficiency.

positions.title: Principal Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Led a team of 6 Solution Architects tasked with improving delivery quality, enabling standardization of design and seeking continuous improvement across the engineering organization:
•	Key participant in the definition of the new global implementation methodology.
•	Directed Solutions Architects on customer implementation projects.
•	Developed well-documented procedures and well-designed templates, realizing improved quality of delivery.
•	Improved the quality of technical design by mentoring technical resources in the use of standard design patterns that introduce flexibility and extensibility into delivered functionality.
•	Created an estimation, planning and costing model that reduced process time and improved accuracy.
•	Ran technical architectural workshops with customers and prospects.
•	Drove initiative to increase application performance in highly intensive processing areas.

positions.title: Framework Architect  - US Technology Centre
positions.description:
Head Framework Architect, tasked with the introduction of the new technical architecture to the US development teams:
•	Knowledge transfer to, and mentoring of development, delivery and product management teams.
•	Successful transfer of the product to the new technical architecture.
•	Lead architect role on several customer projects.
•	Continued development of the Group’s application framework.  The application framework is a key element of the development architecture used by the Group’s engineering teams in the creation of complex applications for both internal use and for a large portfolio of global customers; primarily within the insurance sector.
•	Provided technical training and mentoring to offshore partner development teams which facilitated the growth of development capability

positions.title: Technical Design Authority
positions.description:
Management of a 10-man technical team, responsible for the design and delivery of functionality for customer projects.
•	Under tight timescales (4 months), designed and implemented a stand-alone rating and policy upload solution for a tier 1 insurance company, that enabled the addition of a key distribution partner/book of business ahead of peak sales time. 
•	Development Team Lead on a large project for a tier 1 insurance company, culminating in the successful implementation of a product that is still in use today.  The application allows the management of both vehicle and property claims.
•	Creation of an application development reference website, used as the single source of technical reference data.
•	Design and implementation of Remedy helpdesk and CRM configuration.
•	Production of Management Information data using a mixture of database skills and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Senior Analyst Programmer
positions.description:
Responsible for business analysis and design to produce intuitive business solutions from client’s high-level specifications:
•	Analysis, design and successful implementation of a business software solution for membership and training organizations.  The application provides a central framework to allow access to information across all business areas, creating an environment that provides membership, education, training, event management, recruitment and internet functionality all feeding from a core contact database.
•	Instigated major changes in departmental procedures for:
o	Change control documentation, control and reporting.
o	Database change request documentation, control and reporting.
o	Design workshops.
o	Testing and delivery strategy

positions.title: MBT Commander
positions.description:
A progressive career in the Royal Hussars (PWO) cavalry regiment, serving in the UK, Germany, Canada and Cyprus.
•	Command of a Main Battle Tank.
•	Control of a 9-man team maintaining multi-million-pound equipment.
•	Command of a 10-man security team.
•	Command of a small vehicle borne security section, patrolling sovereign base area boundaries in Cyprus.
